question.text: SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015 Chapters IXA and IXB apply to:

answer.text: Listed Not-for-Profit Organisations (NPOs) and For-Profit Social Enterprises (FPEs) on the SSE respectively
Any company with equity shares listed on a recognised stock exchange
Only private limited companies seeking preferential allotment
Only foreign portfolio investors investing in SSE

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter IXA of LODR covers on-going disclosure and compliance obligations for NPOs listed on SSE (post ZCZP listing). Chapter IXB covers on-going obligations for FPEs designated as SE on SSE. Both chapters add SE-specific continuous-disclosure layers on top of the generic LODR framework. The Trap: Option A is the generic LODR scope, not the SSE-specific chapters. Option C is wrong — preferential allotment is in ICDR, not LODR. Option D is wrong — FPIs are not the subject of these chapters. Cross-Exam Context: III-A / III-C (Compliance) reference the broader LODR framework; XXIII drills into IXA/IXB which are SE-post-listing-specific. The split between NPO (IXA) and FPE (IXB) mirrors the SE eligibility bifurcation. Assessor's Pro-Tip: In your annual engagement, open both LODR IXA (if NPO) or IXB (if FPE) side-by-side with ICDR Reg 292H. The disclosure obligations overlap — the SIA cross-references each LODR clause to the ICDR clause to ensure no gap in the SE compliance calendar.
